I'm not actually getting tagged by the @Alblaka, for whatever reason. But I just started up a round, noticed that the things I have mentioned had been fixed, came here to thank you and... well, thanks for listening <3
The event I was referring to is labelled "Developement: Laying Eggs".
If the queen is on the board, remove it, if it's not on the board, add an egg to the nest.
I mean, that could as well mean that I'm meant to move an egg from the nest space (on the intruder board) to the actual nest tile, but that would conflict if the Nest hasn'tbeen discovered yet (and usually cards explicitely mention 'do X if the Nest has been discovered' when referring to that tile). Plus, what would an egg even do on the Nest tile... it has no effect and you can access all eggs when on that tile anyways.

The team talked about this in depth during our game last night and we have asked AR for clarification. For now we are thinking that there is a hard limit of 8 eggs in the nest (represented by the egg stack on the Intruder Board) - if 8 eggs are present and you draw Development: Laying Eggs - you simple ignore the egg addition. However, if an egg had been destroyed you would then re-add that egg to the stack (if a discarded egg token was available).
That's our house rule for the time being until AR gets back to us.
the answer will be posted here when they do. https://boardgamegeek.com/thread/1921477/pnp-rules-faq

## Intruder Weakness Cards

During game setup , you placed 3 random Weakness cards (face down) on the 3 Intruder Weakness slots on the Intruder board. During the game you will have the possibility to discover these 3 Weaknesses. They represent the crew gaining gradual knowledge on the lifeform that infests the ship.

Each of the 3 Weakness cards is placed in a space corresponding to a different Object:

  1. Character Corpse
  2. Intruder Egg
  3. Intruder Carcass.
Image

To discover a given Weakness card, any Character must research the corresponding Object in the Laboratory Room.

Object tokens:

Image

After researching an Object, reveal the corresponding Weakness card - flip it face up and leave it on the Intruder board.

Discovered Weakness cards modify the basic rules of the Intruders, giving all players a small advantage against them.

【turn991506search4】 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: today; Throwing your uniques with 0lp into the egg is the main use of nemesis.
Omens is a kill in a circle mechanic that drops Altars and Omen Idols. The idols are very rng but can be much stronger than normal class idols. For altars you're usually looking for increases to prefixes and suffixes in refracted slots and increased number of Omen Idols equipped. You will also get timeglass fragments from omen stuff and you can go to the snake lady on the island in the middle of End of Time to trade them. Early on the most value is trading for ancient bones. Eventually you want to buy and complete the boss woven echo, but it's not an immediate priority.
Nemesis is the guys you click on to empower items. Once you get to higher level zones you will also get eggs in the menu that let you insert your own unique and then empower it. Throwing your uniques with 0lp into the egg is the main use of nemesis. Once you're in empowered you can very rarely get double t7s via empowering the naturally appearing exalteds, but there's a lot of luck involved. The nemesis will drop a lot of affix shards when you kill it which is useful early on.
